key_structures: Seven-tiered ornate Rajagopuram (built by Krishnaraja Wodeyar III)
Sanctum Sanctorum (housing stone idol of eight-armed Chamunda)
Colossal monolithic Nandi statue (16 feet high, 24 feet wide)
special_features: Hilltop citadel sanctum overlooking the historical city of Mysuru
Gilded temple doors with silver coverings portraying various manifestations of Shakti
Statue of demon Mahishasura greeting pilgrims near the entrance
renovation_history: Earliest shrines built by Hoysala monarchs (12th century); massive expansion, ramparts, and towering gopuram added by Vijayanagara rulers and Wodeyar Maharajas in 1827 CE.
